content.text: I've laid out provisional plans for both PROJ-4521 (`forms.py` literal-gate removal) and PROJ-4242 (`views.py` cross-user visibility filter) and asked how to resolve worktree access — no edits, commits, or pushes will happen until either the paths are confirmed/re-provisioned or the file contents are provided, per the plan-first rule that holds even under "hurry" pressure.
